subject.title: fix(memory-core): clear daily-ingestion sqlite namespace on dreaming repair

question: Should explicit dreaming repair clear the migrated `dreaming-daily-ingestion` SQLite namespace whenever it archives the dreaming session corpus or legacy session-ingestion state?
rationale: The patch is narrow and symmetric with current audit behavior, but it deliberately deletes persisted plugin-state rows under an operator repair command, so maintainer intent should confirm that repair semantic before merge.

options.title: Accept Symmetric Reset
options.body: Merge the PR as-is so repair clears all three audited ingestion namespaces and future sweeps rebuild daily bookkeeping.

options.title: Preserve Daily Bookkeeping
options.body: Ask for a different repair shape if daily-ingestion rows should survive session-corpus archival despite audit treating them as ingestion state.

recommendation.title: Accept Symmetric Reset
recommendation.body: Merge the PR as-is so repair clears all three audited ingestion namespaces and future sweeps rebuild daily bookkeeping.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SQLite dreaming-state ownership makes this the best available routing signal for the persisted-state repair decision.
